definitions.explanation: To give a formal or official account of something to someone in authority.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}を{上司|じょうし}に{報告|ほうこく}した。
examples.english: I reported the results to my boss.

examples.japanese: {進捗状況|しんちょくじょうきょう}を{報告|ほうこく}してください。
examples.english: Please report on the progress status.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}に{事故|じこ}を{報告|ほうこく}しなければならない。
examples.english: I must report the accident to the police.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {報告書|ほうこくしょ}: report (document)
- {報告|ほうこく}を{受|う}ける: to receive a report
- {中間報告|ちゅうかんほうこく}: interim report
- {最終報告|さいしゅうほうこく}: final report

BUSINESS USAGE:
In Japanese companies, {報告|ほうこく} is one of the three key workplace communication concepts: 報連相 (ほうれんそう) - {報告|ほうこく} (report), {連絡|れんらく} (contact), {相談|そうだん} (consult).
